qutuγ-tu γaǰar-un ǰirüken-ü ǰaγun naiman ner-e-yin toγtaγal-un tarni-luγ-a nigen-e
a-a ry-a gṣiti garbi-yin jaγun ner-e toγtaγal tarni-luγ-a nigen-e mandal-un yeke qaγan,
item.coloph: kümün-ü eǰen ṱai erketü / delekei-tekin-ü qormusta-yin ǰarliγ-iyar, samdan sengge töbed-ün kelen-eče, / mongγol-un ayalγus-tur orčiγulǰu nayiraγuluγad orosiγulbai. , .
item.colophTitle: qutuγ-tu γaǰar-un ǰirüken-ü ǰaγun naiman neretü. toγtaγal tarni-luγ-a, nigen-e tegüsügsen burqan / üman nököd-lüge nigen-e-yin ǰaγun naiman neretü toγtaγal tarni tegüsbei. , .
